mutants.description: Introduces early return on first mismatch detection, creating timing side-channel vulnerability. Function exits immediately when any byte differs, allowing attacker to measure execution time and recover reference_token byte-by-byte.
mutants.expected_detection: Timing tests must detect cycle count variation between all-match case and first-byte-mismatch case. Static analysis must detect return statement inside loop body. Test marker: [FAIL] SR1

mutants.description: Replaces bitwise OR with short-circuit logical OR operator, introducing potential early termination in expression evaluation. Creates control-flow timing variation based on when first mismatch is detected.
mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis must detect use of logical OR (||) operator on secret byte comparisons instead of bitwise OR (|). Test marker: [FAIL] SR3

mutants.description: Adds break statement on mismatch detection, causing loop to terminate early when bytes differ. Violates requirement for exactly 16 iterations in all cases, creating timing side-channel.
mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis must detect break statement inside loop body. Dynamic analysis must verify loop iteration count varies with input. Test marker: [FAIL] SR2

mutants.description: Removes loop bound pragma annotation, allowing synthesizer to infer potentially variable loop bounds. May result in non-constant timing or synthesis failure.
mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis must detect missing #pragma HLS loop_bound annotation. Synthesis verification must fail or detect unbounded loop. Test marker: [FAIL] SR2

mutants.description: Uses ternary operator with secret-dependent condition inside loop, creating data-dependent control flow. Replaces accumulator pattern with conditional assignment that may synthesize to multiplexer with timing variation.
mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis must detect ternary operator (? :) applied to secret byte comparison results. RTL analysis must detect data-dependent multiplexer. Test marker: [FAIL] SR5
